Buttermilk Biscuits
By: Yuna Wu
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 1:21am

Ingredients




2 cups all purpose flour
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
2 teaspoons baking powder
1 teaspoon salt
1/4 cup Lard
3/4 cup buttermilk or sour milk

Preparation

1 Sift together dry ingredients. 2 Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. 3 Add buttermilk; stir just until the dough clings together on a lightly floured board, knead dough gently about 10 to 12 strokes. 4 Roll to 1/2" thickness. 5 Cut with a 2" round biscuit cutter. 6 Place on a greased baking sheet. 7 Bake at 450 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

About


These cook up well at camp. Bring the dry ingredients premixed from home and mix up right when you need to.
